name: llm-qwen2.5-1.5b
description: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct read at the answer token. Zero-shot, no fine-tuning by this project.

calibration.note: Fitted with training/calibrate.py on held-back rows of data/calib.jsonl (public gold-labelled tasks): choice and yes/no minimise negative log-likelihood, score minimises the error of the expected level.

summary: Small and fast: 59% at about 0.07 s per request, in 3 GB.
use_when: You need speed and have little memory, and the questions are straightforward.
avoid_when: Hard or multi-step judgments: it answers only about a third of the hard tier correctly.
